title: Train running though mall
content: Does anyone ever have a dream of a train that runs through the mall? The train would transport shoppers to different areas of the shopping village and would have different train stations for each area.There is always a waterfall in the middle of the store and the train would run through it. I often have dream of me going to my local mall and it would look the same as it always does it real life but the further I walk the bigger the store looks and begin to make multilevel and look like this.
